title: 3rd trial journalist Tohru Kusuma
paragraphs: The 3rd trial for false news broadcasts against journalist Kiras Jambi, Tohru Kusuma, has been made.
According to the charges, Tohru Kusuma published a story about a wild logging in the forest on April 28, 2026 that the prosecutor judged to broadcast a lie.
The trial was held at the Jambi State Court on July 21, 2026, where the panel of judges delayed the trial until August 11, 2026.
In the matter of Tohru Kusuma, the legal authorities of Agus Santoso referred to it as being convicted without asking the expert opinion of the Press Council.
Tohru Kusuma works as a reporter at Jambi.
The prosecutor will read the charges to the next trial.
